units.source_text: 白100封盘，大竹七段应该早在三个月前就看出来。

en.t: Otaka 7-dan must have seen as early as three months ago that White 100 would be the sealed move.

units.source_text: 我们这些外行人认为，接着的黑101只有打入右下角白空的一着，而这一着也只有在二路跳进的一手。

en.t: We amateurs thought that Black 101 had only one move: to invade White's territory in the lower right corner, and even that move could only be a jump in on the second line.

units.source_text: 可是到了十二点午休，大竹七段也没有下这一手。

en.t: But by the noon recess, Otaka 7-dan still had not played that move.
